videos.description: an array of ids of videos made with the relevant project

data_collection.description: An object with the captions the user would have to provide e.g. name captions, custom overlay text

data_collection_id.description: The propery name must match the id of a data collection item in the project. The value must be a string.

overrides.description: Here you can override certain properties for videos

contributor_index.description: The property name must be in the format contributor_<index> where the index is of the video contribution. In a ShoutOut video this will always be 0, in a Multi-clip video it will be 0, 1, 2 etc...

data_collection.description: An object with the captions the user would have to provide e.g. name captions, custom overlay text

<data_collection_id>.description: The propery name must match the id of a data collection item in the project. The value must be a string.

video_url.description: The url of the video file from which the ShoutOut video will be created

assets.description: The custom assets that have been uploaded for this project

qr_code.description: A link to the record link for the project

OAuth2.description: Authentication follows an oauth2 process, outlined in the documentation located here: https://www.oauth.com/oauth2-servers/authorization/the-authorization-request/
